282:The Babu Banarasi Das Institute of Technology and Management (BBDITM) formerly known as Babu Banarasi Das National Institute of Technology and Management (BBDNITM), AKTU Code: 054 is a prominent educational institution in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. It was established in 1998 under the Babu Banarasi Das Educational Society, which is named after the former Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Late Babu Banarasi Das Ji. The institute aims to provide high-quality education in the fields of engineering and other professional studies. BBDITM is affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, and is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).  The institute offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various disciplines of Engineering and Management. Popular programs include B.Tech. (Bachelor of Technology) in branches like Computer Science and Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering (AI & ML), Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science),Information Technology, Civil, Mechanical, Electronics & Communication and Electrical Engineering. In 2023, three departments CSE, ECE, IT at BBDITM received NBA accreditation.
284:The BBDITM campus is well-equipped with modern infrastructure, including state-of-the-art laboratories, smart classrooms, libraries, sports facilities, auditorium, hostels, and seminar halls etc.The campus is designed to offer a conducive environment for academic, cultural, and extracurricular activities. BBDITM boasts a highly qualified faculty with significant academic and industrial experience, fostering a culture of research and innovation among students. The institution emphasizes research activities and encourages students and faculty to engage in projects, research publications, and conferences. The institute has a dedicated placement cell that collaborates with leading companies and recruiters for student internships and placements.
286:Regular workshops, industry visits, and guest lectures are conducted to keep students updated with the latest industry trends and skills. BBDITM offers a vibrant student life with numerous clubs, societies, and events. Cultural festivals, technical fests, and sports events are organized annually. The Institute

The Babu Banarasi Das Institute of Technology and Management (BBDITM) formerly known as Babu Banarasi Das National Institute of Technology and Management (BBDNITM), AKTU Code: 054 is a prominent educational institution in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. It was established in 1998 under the Babu Banarasi Das Educational Society, which is named after the former Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Late Babu Banarasi Das Ji. The institute aims to provide high-quality education in the fields of engineering and other professional studies. BBDITM is affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, and is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).  The institute offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various disciplines of Engineering and Management. Popular programs include B.Tech. (Bachelor of Technology) in branches like Computer Science and Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering (AI & ML), Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science),Information Technology, Civil, Mechanical, Electronics & Communication and Electrical Engineering. In 2023, three departments CSE, ECE, IT at BBDITM received NBA accreditation.

The BBDITM campus is well-equipped with modern infrastructure, including state-of-the-art laboratories, smart classrooms, libraries, sports facilities, auditorium, hostels, and seminar halls etc.The campus is designed to offer a conducive environment for academic, cultural, and extracurricular activities. BBDITM boasts a highly qualified faculty with significant academic and industrial experience, fostering a culture of research and innovation among students. The institution emphasizes research activities and encourages students and faculty to engage in projects, research publications, and conferences. The institute has a dedicated placement cell that collaborates with leading companies and recruiters for student internships and placements.

Regular workshops, industry visits, and guest lectures are conducted to keep students updated with the latest industry trends and skills. BBDITM offers a vibrant student life with numerous clubs, societies, and events. Cultural festivals, technical fests, and sports events are organized annually. The institute promotes holistic development through these activities, helping students develop leadership and teamwork skills.
